title: dspant: Digital Signal Processing for Analysis Toolkit
description:
dspant (Digital Signal Processing for Analysis Toolkit) is a Python package with a Rust core for processing electrophysiological time series. It loads recordings lazily with Dask for out-of-core processing and stores data and metadata in an open format based on Parquet and JSON (.ant).

This archival deposit contains the complete codebase, Rust implementations, analysis pipelines, user documentation, and reproduction scripts for every figure and metric corresponding to the publication:

Penaloza-Aponte JD, Dale EA. Invasive diaphragm electromyography data acquisition and analysis in rodents. Biomedical Signal Processing and Control (under revision).

Note: This repository is an archival scientific artifact provided strictly "as is" without ongoing maintenance, updates, or technical support.
